_comment: PRIMARY ARM. Isolates BindingGYM's inter-assay TRAINING STRATEGY while holding everything H3-DDG owns fixed. Model architecture AND model training parameters are H3-DDG's; only data loading (within-assay batches, uniform assay sampling) and the training strategy (listMLE, epoch selection on per-DMS Spearman) come from BindingGYM.
_comment_from_h3ddg: Model training parameters, from H3-DDG Appendix A.4: Adam, lr 4e-4, no weight decay, no LR schedule, 20,000 total iterations. batch_size 2 is A.4's own upper value ('a batch size of 1, 2') and is simultaneously the smallest slate listMLE can rank -- so it satisfies both sides rather than being an arbitrary pick.
_comment_from_bindinggym: Training strategy, from BindingGYM training/{main.py,dataset.py,loss.py}: listMLE over a same-assay slate, assays drawn uniformly, 256 optimiser steps per epoch (their __len__ of batch_size*256), epoch chosen by validation per-DMS Spearman with patience 3. max_epochs 78 caps total steps at 256*78 = 19,968, i.e. H3-DDG's 20,000 budget rather than BindingGYM's 100 epochs.
_comment_select: Official early-stops on the FULL held-out fold every epoch, ~0.5h/epoch here. A fixed evenly-spaced 300-rows-per-assay subsample is used for selection instead; the selected weights are then scored once on the full fold.
_comment_model: Model architecture, identical to config/train_h3-ddg.json and config/train_h3-ddg_bindinggym.json -- verified field by field.
